# Levels

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/levels.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The 111 level records of `levelNames` (`CfgLevelName`), in the order the game keeps them. A level loads
from `<name>.lev` and its section packs `<name>_<k>.pak` ([Level loading](../research/level-loading.md)).

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every record is listed with every field. `.lev` and pack counts come from the WAD names list, so a
    level whose files have no recovered name shows none. Kinds are hand-written: only the front end and
    the test levels so far.

111 entries. Data: `research/references/levels.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: inferred.

- config_preload3.lua, levelNames

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | int | | Level record index (`GetCurrentLevelIndex`); the list's position minus one. |
| `name` | str | | Level name: `<name>.lev`, `<name>.lua`, `MenuLoadLevel(name)`. |
| `world` | str | | Streamed world name (`<world>s` / `<world>d`). |
| `number` | int | | Level number (`GetLevelId`); names the intro movie `L<n>_IN`. |
| `kind` | str | yes | Our reading of what the level is (story mission, hub, rumble arena, test ...). |
| `sections` | int | | Record `+0x08`: number of sections (packs `<name>_<k>.pak`). |
| `order` | int | | Record `+0x0c`: a small number rising through the story list (meaning not traced). |
| `flag1` | str | | First `LT_*` value (record flag bit 0). |
| `intro` | str | | Second `LT_*` value: `LT_PLAY` sets flag bit 1, play the intro movie. |
| `outro` | str | | Third `LT_*` value: `LT_PLAY` sets flag bit 2, play an outro movie. |
| `lock` | str | | `LOCKED` or `UNLOCKED` (record `+0x10`). |
| `map` | list | | Three floats (record `+0x6c`-`+0x74`); x and y look like a map position (inferred). |
| `v78` | hex | | Record `+0x78`: a word in two 16-bit halves (meaning not traced). |
| `subway` | str | | `SUBWAY_*` line constant (record `+0x7c`). |
| `v80` | hex | | Record `+0x80`: a word in two 16-bit halves (meaning not traced). |
| `has_lev` | bool | | Whether `<name>.lev` exists on the disc (a level without one cannot load). |
| `packs` | int | | Number of `<name>_<k>.pak` packs on the disc. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
